column2: Six steps, based on the Horizons rulebook

Your rulebook is the Imperium: Horizons one, your box is Imperium: Classics. Good news: the core rules are the same, and the Horizons rulebook is the clearest and most up to date. This tutorial teaches you everything that matters with Classics and tells you what to leave aside.

The five ideas of the game
Imperium rests on five simple ideas. Keep them in mind and the rest of the rules almost follows by itself.
